store.summary: ST25R3916 NFC scanner, InductiveNet & DumpNet ML, NDEF/EMV & .nfc studio
store.description: NFC Studio unlocks the ST25R3916 13.56 MHz transceiver on CardputerZero Cap CC1101 & NFC. Scan ISO14443-A/B/F/V tags, inspect hex dumps and NDEF/EMV records, classify 10 card ecosystems and 32D fingerprints with Pure-Go INT8 NFC-DumpNet, detect metals and dielectric moisture with NFC-InductiveNet, emulate 4B/7B UIDs with Reader IAT auto-pause, program battery-free Waveshare NFC e-Paper badges, sync .nfc databases, and expose 28 tools via opt-in stdio MCP.
